name: Sacred Line II
source:
This time, step into the shoes of Sarah, a protagonist with a haunted past, who is forcibly taken by the religious cult Svete Namjere (“Holy Intentions”). Despite a fatal attack from one of the cult members, Sarah is mysteriously resurrected and thrust back into the world of the living. Set against the backdrop of an alternate reality where Yugoslavia persisted in 1999, she is the solitary beacon trying to hold back the forces of national disintegration.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/megacatstudios/sacred-line-2-an-original-game-for-sega-genesis-mega-drive/description]Kickstarter[/url]]
translation:
这一次，你将成为因往事而饱受折磨的莎拉。她被名为“神圣意志”（Svete Namjere）的邪教强行带走，死于一名教徒的袭击，却又神秘复活，被抛回生者的世界。故事设定在南斯拉夫于1999年仍然存续的架空现实中。面对使国家分崩离析的力量，莎拉成了独自试图挡住它的那一点微光。

［摘自[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/megacatstudios/sacred-line-2-an-original-game-for-sega-genesis-mega-drive/description]Kickstarter[/url]］
